title: Clock Angle Calculator
description: Enter a time to get the smaller angle between the hour and minute hands, with the formula and a dial drawing.
howto: Read both angles and see the hands drawn on the dial.

faqs.q: Why does the hour hand move 0.5° per minute?
faqs.a: It sweeps 30° per hour, so each minute carries it 30/60 = 0.5° toward the next hour.
The smaller of the two angles between the hands; the reflex (larger) one is shown too.
About every 65 minutes — e.g. near 1:05, 2:10, … solving 30h = 5.5m.
